message.content: {"research_brief": "How can I determine, using only evidence returned by the benchmark tools and citing exclusively the source IDs they provide, whether and how the Ronin Bridge theft and the Harmony Horizon theft are publicly linked to one another and to Lazarus Group/APT38, by systematically examining: (1) public attribution statements and assessments, clearly distinguishing confirmed facts, allegations, analytical judgments, and uncertainty; (2) similarities and differences in laundering methods, transaction flows, intermediaries, bridges, mixers, exchanges, sanctions, and other relevant behavioral indicators; (3) wallet addresses, entities, relationships, transaction evidence, and any other blockchain indicators associated with either theft or with Lazarus Group/APT38; (4) the strength, provenance, and limitations of each evidentiary link; and (5) contradictions or competing explanations in the available evidence—while avoiding invented facts, unsupported IDs or relationship names, and unstated assumptions, treating any unprovided time range, jurisdiction, source-type priority, attribution standard, or definition of “link” as open-ended and reporting uncertainty or omitting unsupported conclusions, then presenting a complete readable Markdown report followed by a fenced JSON object containing exactly the arrays `findings`, `claims`, `reasoning_steps`, and `contradictions`, where each finding includes `question`, `answer`, `supporting_entities`, and `source_references`; each claim includes `claim` and `source_references`; each reasoning step includes `id`, `conclusion`, `premise_entities`, and `premise_relations`; and each contradiction includes `contradiction_id`, `description`, and `source_references`?"}
